name: Pictures
what_it_does: Inserts a picture from This Device, the Stock Images library, or Online Pictures; a selected picture activates the Picture Format contextual tab (measured).
behavior: Opens Pictures (menu). Contents (4 controls): This Device..., Generate an Image..., Stock Images..., Online Pictures.... Sub-surfaces: ui:flyout-anchor-insert-pictures-menu-this-device, ui:flyout-anchor-insert-pictures-menu-stock-images. [flyout of subfeature:insert-pictures — commands/tiles are endpoints; openers descended per the depth-endpoint rule; sections: Insert Picture From] Appears as a photo of mountains and sun, labelled 'Pictures'.
